title: Stephen Dick paper on UFOs as cellular-automata-like steering system

tellings.quote: Stephen Dick, who is a NASA adviser, um, wrote a paper about UFOs themselves being part of some sort of, you know, computational almost like cellular automata

plain: Steven J. Dick, an adviser to NASA, the US space agency, wrote a paper suggesting UFOs might be part of some kind of computational system, a bit like cellular automata, which are grids of cells following simple rules that build up complex patterns, according to Michels. Michels brings it up from memory and does not name the paper or say when it was written. If the idea holds, UFOs would be less like visiting ships and more like parts of a larger system steering events.
